description: This file defines the 'Probe' class within the WPEFramework plugin namespace, including nested classes for WebTransform, Listener, Broadcaster, and Instance. It appears to implement a network probe mechanism with multicast/broadcast capabilities, handling Web requests and responses, and managing instances with URL, latency, model, and security attributes.

classes.name: Probe
classes.description: Main class implementing network probing with multicast/broadcast capabilities, managing instances, and handling Web requests/responses.

classes.name: Probe::WebTransform
classes.description: Handles transformation of Web request data for socket buffer processing.

classes.name: Probe::Listener
classes.description: Listens for incoming Web requests and responses, manages request validation and response creation.

classes.name: Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Handles broadcasting of M-SEARCH requests over the network, manages destinations, and signs requests if security is enabled.

classes.name: Probe::Instance
classes.description: Represents a discovered probe instance with URL, latency, model, and security attributes.

methods.name: WebTransform::Transform
methods.description: Transforms Web request data into a socket data frame.

methods.name: Listener::LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a body to a partial Web request.

methods.name: Broadcaster::Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping (broadcast) with specified TTL.

methods.name: Broadcaster::SendData
methods.description: Prepares and sends data over the socket datagram.

methods.name: Broadcaster::CreateRequest
methods.description: Creates a multicast search request, signs it if security is enabled.

methods.name: Probe::Report
methods.description: Reports a discovered probe instance with URL, latency, model, and security info.
